components.css: .ds-band{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 300px;gap:32px;padding:64px 32px;background:var(--flag-red,#d42a2a);color:#fff;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--ink,#111318);font-family:Archivo,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif}.ds-band__title{margin:0;font-size:2.5rem;font-weight:800;line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-0.03em;text-transform:uppercase;font-variation-settings:'wdth' 125;max-width:18ch}.ds-band__lede{margin:16px 0 0;font-size:1.125rem;line-height:1.45;color:rgb(255 255 255/0.9)}.ds-hoist{position:relative;padding:24px 0 4px}.ds-hoist__rope{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;border-left:1.5px solid currentColor}.ds-hoist__pos{display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:16px;animation:ds-hoist 640ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1) both}.ds-hoist__pos svg{transition:transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1)}.ds-hoist__pos:hover svg{transform:translateY(-3px)}.ds-hoist__name{font:800 1.1875rem/1.2 Archivo,sans-serif;font-variation-settings:'wdth' 75;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;padding:0;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:transparent;text-underline-offset:0.18em;transition:text-decoration-color 200ms}.ds-hoist__pos:hover .ds-hoist__name{text-decoration-color:currentColor}.ds-hoist__name:focus-visible{outline:2px solid currentColor;outline-offset:8px}.ds-hoist__reason{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:0.875rem;line-height:1.45;color:rgb(255 255 255/0.9)}@keyframes ds-hoist{from{transform:translateY(48px);opacity:0}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-hoist__pos{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
Every finding is a signal run up a halyard. The site borrows the one visual language the sea already uses to say "stop your vessel" or "negative" at a distance: flat flag cloth in signal red, blue, yellow, black and white, cut nearly square, each flag edged in the same even ink line. Verdicts are real code flags chosen for their meaning at sea, confidence is a row of numeral pennants, and each mini-challenge opens on a full field of its pennant colour with its suspects hoisted on a vertical halyard. It turns away from both the dark neon graph dashboard and the cream editorial report: the ground is sail-white, the ink is near-black, and colour arrives in large flat fields or as small, exact marks, never as glow or gradient.

Density follows the reader. Bands and the home hero are loud and spacious (96px vertical padding, display type at the expanded width), while the evidence beneath is a working instrument: white figure panels with ink borders, 12px chart text, chips that toggle state, and a table view behind every chart. Archivo's width axis carries the hierarchy: expanded (125) for display, normal (100) for reading, condensed (75) for numbers and identifiers.

Motion has one authored moment: the hoist, where flags rise into place on a slow, settling curve. Everything else is quick, quiet UI feedback.
keyCharacteristics: Flat signal cloth; no gradients, no glow, no dark mode.
One even 1.5px ink line edges flags, panels, controls and section breaks.
Nearly square cut corners (2px) on every control and panel.
Verdict and confidence are always a flag plus words, never colour alone.
Claims sit beside their evidence and drive what the evidence shows.

rules.name: The Signal Cloth Rule
rules.body: Categorical marks use only signal cloth, in a fixed order: blue, gold, red, black, white. Blue, gold and red are validated with the dataviz validator on the sail-white ground. Black and white never carry meaning by colour alone: their fills are ink-outlined, and as lines black is solid while slot 5 is drawn as dashed ink. Colour follows the entity, never its rank, and the order is never cycled.

rules.name: The Ink Edge Rule
rules.body: Every yellow or gold mark carries an ink outline, and every flag carries the same 1.5px ink edge, so yellow and white read on a white page.

rules.name: The Flag-Plus-Words Rule
rules.body: A verdict is never a colour swatch. It is the code flag (L Suspect, U Possible, X Insufficient evidence, N Unlikely) plus its label; confidence is three numeral pennants with the unhoisted ones muted, plus the word.

rules.name: The Full Field Rule
rules.body: Each mini-challenge band is a whole field of its pennant colour: MC1 red, MC2 blue, MC3 yellow. Text on red and blue is flag white (secondary text at 90% white); text on yellow is ink.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy moves along Archivo's width axis before it moves along size: expanded for display, normal for reading, condensed for numbers and names. Don't introduce a second family.

rules.name: The Chart Text Floor Rule
rules.body: Chart text is 12px, ink-3, tabular figures; emphasised labels step up to ink at weight 650. Nothing in a chart goes smaller.

rules.name: The Drawn Depth Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by the 1.5px ink line or a cloth-on-ground step, never by a shadow. A cast shadow means the element floats above the page and follows the pointer.

dos: **Do** draw every flag and panel edge with the one 1.5px ink line, and keep corners at 2px.
**Do** pair every verdict with its code flag and its word, and every confidence with three numeral pennants and its word.
**Do** keep categorical marks in the fixed order blue, gold, red, black, white, and outline every gold, black and white fill in ink; draw the fifth slot as a dashed ink line.
**Do** give every figure a finding-stating title, a source caption and a table view.
**Do** let claim buttons set figure state, and pin short answers beside their evidence at 1280px and up.
**Do** keep UI motion between 140 and 200ms on the strong ease-out (`cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)`), moving only transform and opacity; colour state changes may cross-fade over the same timing.
**Do** reserve the hoist (640ms, `cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)`, a 48px rise with a fade, staggered) for flags arriving on a halyard.
**Do** gate hover effects behind `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`, and honour reduced motion by collapsing animations to an instant.
**Do** keep chart text at 12px or larger in ink-3.
donts: **Don't** use gradients, glow, or a dark neon dashboard treatment; colour is flat cloth.
**Don't** use flag yellow (#ffc61a) as a data mark; use signal gold with an ink outline.
**Don't** let black or white carry a category by colour alone.
**Don't** cast shadows on panels, cards or controls; only the floating tooltip lifts.
**Don't** round corners past 2px on rectangular surfaces.
**Don't** add a second typeface beyond monospace for inline code, or carry hierarchy with weight alone when the width axis can do it.
**Don't** add a second authored animation; the hoist is the one moment.
